text:
maria: FYI — planning a burst-capacity cutover for gpu-pool-burst-7 tonight at 23:00 UTC. Goal: replace old autoscale policy (v2) with new smoothing+burst (v3) to reduce oscillation. Low-risk window, but want a quick smoke and rollback plan ready.
ryan: ack. who’s owning the deploy? I can do the orchestration if sam partners on smoke tests.
lisa: I can stand by for rollback and traffic steering. what’s the expected impact?
maria: expected: brief 30–60s instance churn as new policy rolls. throughput shouldn't drop for reserved slices, burst capacity may be temporarily reduced for ~1min. no customer-facing changes.
sam: sounds good. for smoke I’ll run small load generator against the staging slice and validate token latency + successful 200s. sample checks: 
```
# health
curl -sS https://gpu-proxy.staging.internal/health | jq .status
# smoke load (10 qps, 60s)
./tools/smoke-run --target gpu-pool-burst-7 --qps 10 --duration 60 --report smoke.json
```
I’ll also tail pod logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l pool=burst-7 -f --since=2m`
deploy-bot: deploy queued by maria at 2024-11-06T23:00:00Z — pipeline id: deploy-2149997777.
ryan: pinging codeowners for the autoscale policy change PR: PR #4321 includes policy delta + unit tests. @lisa please quick review for rollback knobs.
lisa: on it. main rollback is: flip `autoscale.policy.current = v2` in ConfigMap, run `kubectl rollout restart deploy/pool-orchestrator`, then monitor `pool-eviction` and KPIs. should be <5min to revert.
maria: good. if smoke fails, we abort and revert via the CM flip. sam — what are the KPI thresholds that would trigger abort?
sam: abort if p50 token latency increases >50% over baseline, or error rate >1% sustained for 2 minutes, or if pods fail readiness for >2 consecutive probes. I’ll post a quick dashboard link in a minute.
ryan: also add fallback: route new burst traffic to fallback-pool-3 for flag-window. I’ll pre-create route so it’s a single toggle. command: `infractl route switch --from burst-7 --to fallback-3 --dry-run`
infra-bot: preflight checks OK: node-pools healthy, spare-GPU-count = 12, configmap readable by orchestrator.
lisa: reviewed PR, approved with one nit about metric name. LGTM otherwise.
maria: timeline: 22:45 UTC — final checklist, 23:00 — rollout, 23:02 — run smoke, 23:10 — confirm metrics + close ticket. If rollback needed, target complete by 23:15.
sam: I’ll join at 22:40 to prep smoke harness. ryan, can you create the rollback runbook snippet in the ticket?
ryan: done — ticket #INF-789 has steps + command snippets.
maria: thanks everyone. calling it out in #oncall as well. I’ll post status after smoke. :thumbsup:
